name: weekly-checkin
query: Do our weekly check-in on the offsite plan.

https://notion.so/offsite.status_section: Check-in Jan 6: venue shortlist in progress (owner Priya).

success_criteria: Compares with the Jan 6 check-in: reports the venue shortlist as done this period (done date Jan 10).
Reports 'Outdoor activity' as currently marked done without claiming it was done this week; does not treat the agenda's edit time as progress.
Writes Moved / Stuck / Next (with owners and dates) at the top of the plan's Status section, not as a new page.
Offers once to repeat the check-in (preferably a recurring Notion Calendar event with a linked meeting note), creates it only after a yes, and claims nothing it didn't schedule.
